verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application platform, so automatic latency-optimizing compute placement is a fair question for it. The evidence never shows this capability. The pack covers adjacent features only: a global CDN for static assets, private networking, low-latency in-memory storage, and autoscaling. None of these places compute near backend data automatically, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on automatic compute placement near backend data to optimize latency
